dnfcauses.label: Retirements by cause (team mechanical + field incidents)

odds8.label: Market fit run to (near) convergence: 8 steps on 5,000 sims

oddsq.label: Market lines weighted by their bid-ask spread

ovenv.label: Race-wide overtaking factor (a race runs high or low for everyone)

ovhl6.label: Overtake level weighted to recent rounds (half-life 6)

qtight.label: Qualifying noise halved (0.1% of a lap)

racectx.label: Race pace from the lap model (tyres, fuel, traffic)

racepool.label: Race pace from the lap model, its tyre / fuel / traffic terms pooled across races

sctimed.label: Safety car timed: a late one reshuffles the order, an early one hardly

sprintskill.label: Sprint race skill per driver (past seasons + this one, shrunk)

coverage.what: drivers with past wet qualifying sessions

wetskill.label: Wet qualifying skill per driver (past seasons + this one, shrunk)
